title: Language Surface Normalization Gate
acceptance_criteria: The deterministic grammar baseline and construction families remain reproducible.
Every potentially breaking normalization remains blocked on versioned compatibility/migration evidence.
Parser, AST/IR, compiler service, formatter/migration, IDE/completion, and diagnostics impacts are evaluated before production syntax implementation.
Broad M17-M20 implementation does not bypass the full reviewed normalization gate.

packages.title: E1 Design decision record
acceptance_criteria: every hotspot has a disposition; every normalized row identifies preserved semantic facts; bootstrap, operators, export boundaries and validation order have explicit decisions; no production parser/code change.

packages.title: E2 Compatibility and migration contract
acceptance_criteria: each candidate syntax change has an M7-owned classification rule and migration lifecycle; semantic-equivalent rewrites produce no semantic diff; breaking cases require explicit version/approval.

packages.title: E3 Experimental parser/schema prototype
acceptance_criteria: prototype covers every matrix row plus representative existing families, reports parser/special-case deltas, and demonstrates where the common model fails without changing production behavior.

packages.title: E4 Compiler-service and schema-introspection design/prototype
acceptance_criteria: completion/agent clients can discover representative App/Core/Backend/Sync shapes from compiler-owned data; no client-side semantic reconstruction is required.

packages.title: E5 Formatter and migration prototype
acceptance_criteria: rewrite is idempotent, semantic end state matches, comments/source locations have an explicit preservation policy, and rollback/coexistence behavior is fixture-backed.

packages.title: E6 IDE/completion prototype
acceptance_criteria: representative completion cases do not hard-code a second language schema; old/new syntax is not mixed incorrectly; no IDE layer becomes semantic authority.

packages.title: E7 Diagnostics prototype
acceptance_criteria: diagnostics remain deterministic and source-localized; equivalent invalid constructs produce consistent semantic messages across old/new spellings; no diagnostic silently changes compatibility class.

packages.title: E8 Vendor-neutral before/after evaluation
acceptance_criteria: report compile success, semantic correctness, unnecessary edits, repair loops, regressions, first-pass parse rate, first-pass semantic-validation rate, invented-syntax rate, wrong-placement rate, diagnostics per 100 source lines, semantic-fact recall, and raw counts/deltas; no benefit claim without measured evidence.

packages.title: E9 Breaking implementation proposal
acceptance_criteria: exact grammar/parser/AST/IR/tooling changes, compatibility window, fixtures, conformance impact, migration tooling and release plan are approved before production code changes. M16.5 completion alone never authorizes E9.
